title: Beta: spirit-healer Resurrection Sickness is the full 10 minutes from level 10
claim: Taking the spirit healer in the beta gives the full 10-minute Resurrection Sickness from level 10 (Era: 1 min at level 10, +1 min per level, 10 min from level 20); Blizzard lists 'duration is not correct at lower levels' as an open known issue.
detail: Players on the EU forum report the 10-minute debuff at level 10 throughout the beta. Blizzard's Known Issues thread (Sept 18 entry, still not struck through on Oct 8) says the low-level duration is wrong, so the Era scaling is probably intended. Until fixed: at levels 10-19 a corpse run is almost always faster than the spirit healer. Spirit healer durability loss is 25% (n:20261011-spirit-healer-durability-25).

title: Spirit healer resurrection costs 25% durability (was 50%)
claim: Since the Oct 8 beta build (70291), resurrecting at the spirit healer costs 25% durability instead of 50%.
detail: Listed by ForeverChanges under 'found in the game' for build 70291; not in Blizzard's notes. Resurrection Sickness still applies (n:20261011-res-sickness-10min-from-10). Lowers the repair-cost side of a spirit res; the time cost (sickness) is unchanged.

title: Hunter: Truthseeker's Bow now requires level 40 (was 30)
claim: The hunter quest reward Truthseeker's Bow (book-collecting quest) was hotfixed around Oct 9-10 from required level 30 to 40, retroactively; equipped bows from earlier can no longer be used below 40.
detail: Players say it was the best level-30 ranged upgrade; the change looks like a bug fix (other quest rewards in the chain already showed 40). Plan it as a level-40 upgrade, not a level-30 one. The book-collecting quest itself is still doable earlier. Stats unchanged per the thread.

title: Shaman level 30 chain 'The Tempest's Weapons': steps, zones, and Oct 8 drop/respawn buffs
claim: After the wind totem quest, Shamans at 30 get Elemental Aid (loot Charlga Razorflank, RFK), Storm, Earth, and Fire (20 twisted totems from Dustwallow murlocs 36-39, Desolace centaurs 37-39, Swamp of Sorrows Lost Ones 34-37, Badlands troggs/Dustbelcher ogres 39+) and Heed My Call (level-40 elite waves at Thousand Needles), turned in to Bath'rah the Windwatcher in Alterac (80.4, 66.8) for Rage of the Storm / Lightning's Grasp / Tidebringer's Claw plus Elementalist's Guard.
detail: The Oct 8 build made the totem mobs respawn faster and drop totems more often (Maraudine Scouts drop Twisted Air Totems, Ongeku Earth, Murdaloc and Dustbelcher ogres Fire; big camps like Dustbelch Grotto respawn faster), and Eye of the Tempest became multi-drop. Totem steps fit the 34-40 zones the route already visits; the final step needs a group or level 40. Totem drop rate ~25% (one player's guess). Quest ids 79360/96264, 79358, 79366/96135.

title: Beta /played to about level 30: 21-64 h, median ~34 h (9 characters)
claim: Nine beta characters reported on the US forum reached about level 30 in 21-64 hours /played (median ~34 h); the fastest were Warlocks at 21-22 h.
detail: Most posts don't state the exact level; mixed questing and dungeons, beta cap 20 then 30, many were rerolls with route knowledge. Compare Blizzard's 1-20 average of 20.5 h (n:20261008-leveling-speed-same-as-era). Use to sanity-check the model's 1-30 pace, not as a target.

title: Hunter: with Focused Fire talented, pet stats snapshot on summon
claim: With at least 1 point in Focused Fire, a hunter pet's attack power and other inherited stats stop updating with the hunter's gear and buffs and only refresh when the pet is dismissed and re-summoned (or stabled).
detail: Tester toggled Aspect of the Hawk: pet AP updated with 0-5 Endurance Training, stopped updating as soon as 1 point went into Focused Fire. Workaround while leveling: dismiss and call the pet after equipping upgrades. Open bug, not acknowledged by Blizzard yet.

title: Hunter: Improved Mend Pet 2/2 raises Mend Pet mana cost (bug)
claim: With Improved Mend Pet 2/2, Mend Pet rank 3 costs 186 mana instead of 155 (+20%) rather than the expected 124 (-20%).
detail: Bug report with screenshots; skip the talent while leveling until fixed.

title: RestedXP: Forever questing routes 1-35 done for both factions; 1-20 free
claim: RestedXP's Oct 9 changelog says its Forever questing routes now cover levels 1-35 for Alliance and Horde (125 new quests, Skyborne start, six new race/class combos); 1-20 is free, 35-60 falls back to Classic Era routes until after launch.
detail: Next: a Dungeon Leveling Guide (pre-collect dungeon quests), then 35-60 speedrun/dungeon routes and a 'Discovery' route favouring new Forever quests after launch. Skyborne routes: Horde 1-12, Alliance 1-14. Night elf detour to Loch Modan 14-16. Public repo already has Guides/Forever (Durotar 1-12, Undead 1-14, Barrens 12-22, Alliance 11-20, Skyborne, dungeon variants). Paid tier $30 per faction / $45 both.

title: Recommended level ranges for all 14 Forever dungeons
claim: ForeverDB's dungeon list gives: Ragefire Chasm 13-18, Hall of Thanes 13-20, Wailing Caverns 15-24, Ruins of Lordaeron 15-22, Deadmines 17-26, Shadowfang Keep 20-30, Blackfathom Deeps 24-32, Stockade 24-32, Excavation Site: Wetlands 26-33, Gnomeregan 29-38, Razorfen Kraul 29-38, Scarlet Monastery 30-38, Razorfen Downs 37-46, Uldaman 41-51.
detail: The client has no LFGDungeons rows for these maps, so the ranges are hand-maintained (foreverdb.net, checked Oct 7, copied in the DungeonLens addon). City of Dalaran (~30) and later Forever dungeons (Drowned City, Krol'dok, Alcaz, Blackmaw, Shaper's Terrace) are missing. Dungeon Leveling Companion's Alliance plan: HoT 14-17, DM 17-19, WC 19-20, RoL 20-21, BFD 22-24, RFK 25-26, Gnomer 28-30, SM GY 30-31, Dalaran 31-33, SM Lib 33-35, Drowned City 35-37, SM Arm 37-38, Cath 38-39, Krol'dok 42-44.

title: Cozy Sleeping Bag: +1% XP per minute napped, up to +3% (buff duration 1 h or 2 h)
claim: The Cozy Sleeping Bag (item 211527, quest chain from level 14) gives +1% XP per minute napped on it, up to 3 stacks (+3%), on a 1-hour cooldown; it counts as a rested area and stacks with camp and food buffs.
detail: Duration conflict: guides (from Season of Discovery) say the buff lasts 1 hour; Forever's own loading-screen tip says 'Lie in the Cozy Sleeping Bag for three minutes and you earn 3% more experience for two hours' (ForeverChanges). Client data names the aura Well-Rested (429959) without a readable duration. If it is 2 h on a 1 h cooldown, the buff can be kept up permanently. Chain: Westfall Nailed Plank 37,50 (Alliance start) <-> Barrens Burned-Out Remains 46,74 (Horde start) -> Stonetalon camp near Sun Rock Retreat -> Loch Modan Carved Figurine 49,12 (Stonewrought Dam) -> Hillsbrad northern Thoradin Wall satchel. Not usable in cities or inns; disappears if you move ~100 yd away.

title: Name reservation Oct 27 - Nov 3; launch Nov 4
claim: Early name reservation runs October 27 to November 3, 2026, before the November 4 launch.
detail: Blizzard's roadmap (via warcraft.wiki.gg) and Icy Veins (Sept 15) agree on the window. Timesaver, citing Blizzard's pre-purchase post, gives launch at 3:00 p.m. PST and up to three reserved names; Icy Veins says a first and a second name. Beta characters are wiped. Same dates are in n:20261009-beta-launch-dates.
